AI.title_translation: 使用物理信息Webster模型学习声道的面积和辐射
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个物理信息发声后端渲染器，用于歌唱语音合成，通过训练一个时间域Webster模型来估计可解释的声道面积函数和开端辐射系数，并在持续元音上表现出与DDSP基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了歌唱语音合成，需要一个能够估计可解释的声道面积函数和开端辐射系数的物理信息模型。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一个物理信息发声后端渲染器。它通过训练一个时间域Webster模型作为物理信息神经网络，利用合成的单通道音频和基频轨迹来估计可解释的声道面积函数和开端辐射系数。训练过程强制执行偏微分方程和边界一致性，并使用轻量级DDSP路径来稳定学习，而推理则完全基于物理。
AI.result: 在持续元音（/a/, /i/, /u/）上，由独立的有限差分时域Webster求解器渲染的参数，在频谱包络方面与紧凑的DDSP基线具有竞争力，并且在离散化、适度声源变化和约百分之十的音高变化下保持稳定。然而，图内波形比参考波形更嘶哑。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息Webster模型在歌唱语音合成中能够有效地估计声道参数并生成具有竞争力的频谱包络，但未来工作需要解决波形嘶哑的问题，可能通过周期性感知目标和明确的声门先验。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个用于歌唱语音合成的物理信息发声后端渲染器。给定合成的单通道音频和基频轨迹，我们训练一个时间域Webster模型作为物理信息神经网络，以估计可解释的声道面积函数和开端辐射系数。训练强制执行偏微分方程和边界一致性；一个轻量级的DDSP路径仅用于稳定学习，而推理则纯粹基于物理。在持续元音（/a/, /i/, /u/）上，由独立的有限差分时域Webster求解器渲染的参数，在频谱包络方面与紧凑的DDSP基线具有竞争力，并且在离散化、适度声源变化和约百分之十的音高变化下保持稳定。图内波形比参考波形更嘶哑，这促使未来工作采用周期性感知目标和明确的声门先验。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于歌唱语音合成的物理信息发声后端渲染器。该方法将时间域Webster模型训练为物理信息神经网络，以从合成音频和基频轨迹中估计可解释的声道面积函数和开端辐射系数。模型训练强制满足物理方程和边界条件，并通过轻量级DDSP辅助稳定学习。实验结果表明，在持续元音上，该模型渲染的参数能生成与DDSP基线相当的频谱包络，且在不同条件变化下保持稳定。尽管目前波形略显嘶哑，但该研究为未来结合周期性感知目标和声门先验提供了方向。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, Webster模型, 歌唱语音合成, 声道面积, 辐射系数
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将物理信息神经网络应用于歌唱语音合成，通过Webster模型直接估计可解释的声道参数，这为理解和控制语音生成提供了新的途径。其纯物理推理的特点也增强了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。然而，波形“嘶哑”的问题表明，在声学细节和自然度方面仍有改进空间，未来工作将着重解决这一限制。

title: Audiocards: Structured Metadata Improves Audio Language Models For Sound Design
summary: Sound designers search for sounds in large sound effects libraries using aspects such as sound class or visual context. However, the metadata needed for such search is often missing or incomplete, and requires significant manual effort to add. Existing solutions to automate this task by generating metadata, i.e. captioning, and search using learned embeddings, i.e. text-audio retrieval, are not trained on metadata with the structure and information pertinent to sound design. To this end we propose audiocards, structured metadata grounded in acoustic attributes and sonic descriptors, by exploiting the world knowledge of LLMs. We show that training on audiocards improves downstream text-audio retrieval, descriptive captioning, and metadata generation on professional sound effects libraries. Moreover, audiocards also improve performance on general audio captioning and retrieval over the baseline single-sentence captioning approach. We release a curated dataset of sound effects audiocards to invite further research in audio language modeling for sound design.

AI.title_translation: Audiocards：结构化元数据改进用于声音设计的音频语言模型
AI.tldr: Audiocards，一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的结构化元数据，能够显著提升音频语言模型在声音设计任务（如文本-音频检索和描述性字幕生成）上的表现，优于传统的单句字幕方法。
AI.motivation: 声音设计师在大型音效库中搜索声音时，常因元数据缺失或不完整而面临挑战，且手动添加元数据耗时费力。现有的自动化解决方案（如字幕生成和基于嵌入的检索）未能针对声音设计所需的特定结构和信息进行训练。
AI.method: 本文提出了“audiocards”，一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的世界知识，以声学属性和声音描述符为基础的结构化元数据。研究人员通过在这些audiocards上训练模型，来改进下游任务。
AI.result: 在audiocards上训练的模型显著改善了专业音效库上的文本-音频检索、描述性字幕生成和元数据生成任务。此外，audiocards在通用音频字幕生成和检索方面的表现也优于基线的单句字幕方法。
AI.conclusion: Audiocards作为一种利用LLMs生成结构化元数据的方法，能够有效提升音频语言模型在声音设计和通用音频任务中的性能。研究团队还发布了一个精心策划的音效audiocards数据集，以促进该领域的进一步研究。
AI.translation: 声音设计师使用声音类别或视觉上下文等方面在大声音效果库中搜索声音。然而，这种搜索所需的元数据通常缺失或不完整，需要大量手动工作才能添加。通过生成元数据（即字幕生成）和使用学习到的嵌入进行搜索（即文本-音频检索）来自动化此任务的现有解决方案，并未在针对声音设计相关的结构和信息的元数据上进行训练。为此，我们提出了audiocards，这是一种基于声学属性和声音描述符的结构化元数据，通过利用LLMs的世界知识来实现。我们表明，在audiocards上进行训练可以改善专业音效库上的下游文本-音频检索、描述性字幕生成和元数据生成。此外，audiocards在通用音频字幕生成和检索方面的性能也优于基线单句字幕方法。我们发布了一个精选的音效audiocards数据集，以邀请在声音设计中进行音频语言建模的进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“audiocards”的创新方法，通过利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的世界知识，生成基于声学属性和声音描述符的结构化元数据，以解决声音设计中元数据缺失和不完整的问题。研究表明，在audiocards上训练音频语言模型能显著提升文本-音频检索、描述性字幕生成和元数据生成在专业音效库上的表现，并优于通用音频任务中的传统单句字幕方法。为促进该领域研究，作者还发布了一个精心策划的audiocards数据集。
AI.keywords: Audiocards, 结构化元数据, 音频语言模型, 声音设计, 文本-音频检索
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“audiocards”这一概念，通过利用LLMs的强大语义理解能力，为音频数据生成结构化且与声音设计高度相关的元数据，这比传统的单句字幕提供了更丰富、更具可操作性的信息。这种方法有效地解决了音效库元数据稀缺的痛点，并展示了LLMs在跨模态信息增强方面的潜力。发布数据集也对后续研究具有重要贡献。

title: Speculative Decoding with a Speculative Vocabulary
summary: Speculative decoding has rapidly emerged as a leading approach for accelerating language model (LM) inference, as it offers substantial speedups while yielding identical outputs. This relies upon a small draft model, tasked with predicting the outputs of the target model. State-of-the-art speculative decoding methods use a draft model consisting of a single decoder layer and output embedding matrix, with the latter dominating drafting time for the latest LMs. Recent work has sought to address this output distribution bottleneck by reducing the vocabulary of the draft model. Although this can improve throughput, it compromises speculation effectiveness when the target token is out-of-vocabulary. In this paper, we argue for vocabulary speculation as an alternative to a reduced vocabulary. We propose SpecVocab, an efficient and effective method that selects a vocabulary subset per decoding step. Across a variety of tasks, we demonstrate that SpecVocab can achieve a higher acceptance length than state-of-the-art speculative decoding approach, EAGLE-3. Notably, this yields up to an 8.1% increase in average throughput over EAGLE-3.

AI.tldr: SpecVocab通过在每个解码步骤动态选择词汇子集来改进推测解码，显著提高了语言模型推理的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法中，草稿模型的输出嵌入矩阵在最新语言模型中占据了大部分草稿时间，且简单地减少草稿模型词汇量会损害推测的有效性，因为目标词元可能超出词汇表。
AI.method: 本文提出SpecVocab，一种高效有效的方法，它在每个解码步骤中动态选择一个词汇子集，作为减少词汇量方法的替代方案，以进行词汇推测。
AI.result: SpecVocab在各种任务上实现了比最先进的推测解码方法EAGLE-3更高的接受长度。此外，它使平均吞吐量比EAGLE-3增加了高达8.1%。
AI.conclusion: SpecVocab通过创新的词汇推测方法，动态选择词汇子集，有效解决了现有推测解码的效率瓶颈和词汇量限制，显著提升了语言模型推理的吞吐量和效率。
AI.translation: 推测解码已迅速成为加速语言模型（LM）推理的主要方法，因为它能在产生相同输出的同时提供显著的加速。这依赖于一个小型草稿模型，负责预测目标模型的输出。最先进的推测解码方法使用由单个解码器层和输出嵌入矩阵组成的草稿模型，其中后者在最新的LM中占据了大部分草稿时间。最近的工作试图通过减少草稿模型的词汇量来解决这个输出分布瓶颈。尽管这可以提高吞吐量，但当目标词元超出词汇表时，它会损害推测的有效性。在本文中，我们主张将词汇推测作为减少词汇量的一种替代方案。我们提出了SpecVocab，一种高效有效的方法，它在每个解码步骤中选择一个词汇子集。在各种任务中，我们证明SpecVocab可以实现比最先进的推测解码方法EAGLE-3更高的接受长度。值得注意的是，这使得平均吞吐量比EAGLE-3增加了高达8.1%。
AI.summary: 本文针对语言模型推测解码中草稿模型输出嵌入矩阵的瓶颈及减少词汇量带来的有效性问题，提出了一种名为SpecVocab的新方法。SpecVocab通过在每个解码步骤动态选择一个词汇子集进行词汇推测，而非简单地减少词汇量。实验结果表明，SpecVocab在多种任务上实现了比现有SOTA方法EAGLE-3更高的接受长度，并带来了高达8.1%的平均吞吐量提升。
AI.keywords: 推测解码, 语言模型推理, 词汇推测, SpecVocab, 吞吐量
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的词汇推测方法SpecVocab，通过动态选择词汇子集，有效解决了传统推测解码中输出嵌入矩阵的瓶颈以及减少词汇量带来的局限性。其在不牺牲输出质量的前提下，显著提高了语言模型推理的吞吐量，对加速大型语言模型应用具有重要意义。

title: High-Fidelity Causal Video Diffusion Models for Real-Time Ultra-Low-Bitrate Semantic Communication
summary: We introduce a video diffusion model for high-fidelity, causal, and real-time video generation under ultra-low-bitrate semantic communication constraints. Our approach utilizes lossy semantic video coding to transmit the semantic scene structure, complemented by a stream of highly compressed, low-resolution frames that provide sufficient texture information to preserve fidelity. Building on these inputs, we introduce a modular video diffusion model that contains Semantic Control, Restoration Adapter, and Temporal Adapter. We further introduce an efficient temporal distillation procedure that enables extension to real-time and causal synthesis, reducing trainable parameters by 300x and training time by 2x, while adhering to communication constraints. Evaluated across diverse datasets, the framework achieves strong perceptual quality, semantic fidelity, and temporal consistency at ultra-low bitrates (< 0.0003 bpp), outperforming classical, neural, and generative baselines in extensive quantitative, qualitative, and subjective evaluations.

AI.title_translation: 用于实时超低码率语义通信的高保真因果视频扩散模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种视频扩散模型，用于在超低码率语义通信约束下进行高保真、实时视频生成，通过语义编码和压缩帧实现，并优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是在超低码率语义通信约束下实现高保真、因果和实时视频生成。
AI.method: 该方法利用有损语义视频编码传输语义场景结构，并辅以高度压缩的低分辨率帧提供纹理信息。它引入了一个模块化视频扩散模型，包含语义控制、恢复适配器和时间适配器。此外，还引入了一种高效的时间蒸馏程序，以实现实时和因果合成，显著减少了可训练参数和训练时间。
AI.result: 该框架在超低码率（< 0.0003 bpp）下实现了强大的感知质量、语义保真度和时间一致性。它在广泛的定量、定性和主观评估中优于经典的、神经的和生成式基线。时间蒸馏程序将可训练参数减少了300倍，训练时间减少了2倍。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功展示了一种视频扩散模型，能够在超低码率下为实时语义通信实现高感知质量和语义保真度，并优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种视频扩散模型，用于在超低码率语义通信约束下进行高保真、因果和实时视频生成。我们的方法利用有损语义视频编码来传输语义场景结构，并辅以高度压缩的低分辨率帧流，这些帧提供足够的纹理信息以保持保真度。在此基础上，我们引入了一个模块化视频扩散模型，其中包含语义控制、恢复适配器和时间适配器。我们进一步引入了一种高效的时间蒸馏程序，使其能够扩展到实时和因果合成，在遵守通信约束的同时，将可训练参数减少300倍，训练时间减少2倍。该框架在各种数据集上进行了评估，在超低码率（< 0.0003 bpp）下实现了强大的感知质量、语义保真度和时间一致性，在广泛的定量、定性和主观评估中优于经典的、神经的和生成式基线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于超低码率语义通信的高保真、因果和实时视频扩散模型。它采用有损语义编码传输场景结构，并利用压缩的低分辨率帧提供纹理。该模型包含语义控制、恢复适配器和时间适配器，并通过高效的时间蒸馏程序增强了实时性能。该框架在极低码率下实现了卓越的感知质量、语义保真度和时间一致性，超越了现有基线。
AI.keywords: 视频扩散模型, 语义通信, 超低码率, 实时视频生成, 时间蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文通过将语义通信与视频扩散模型结合，创新性地解决了超低码率下高保真视频生成的挑战。语义控制、模块化适配器和高效时间蒸馏程序的引入是关键贡献。在实现极低码率下卓越性能的同时，显著减少参数和训练时间，突显了其在实时应用中的实际重要性。

title: PrivAct: Internalizing Contextual Privacy Preservation via Multi-Agent Preference Training
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in personalized tasks involving sensitive, context-dependent information, where privacy violations may arise in agents' action due to the implicitness of contextual privacy. Existing approaches rely on external, inference-time interventions which are brittle, scenario-specific, and may expand the privacy attack surface. We propose PrivAct, a contextual privacy-aware multi-agent learning framework that internalizes contextual privacy preservation directly into models' generation behavior for privacy-compliant agentic actions. By embedding privacy preferences into each agent, PrivAct enhances system-wide contextual integrity while achieving a more favorable privacy-helpfulness tradeoff. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in contextual privacy preservation, reducing leakage rates by up to 12.32% while maintaining comparable helpfulness, as well as zero-shot generalization and robustness across diverse multi-agent topologies. Code is available at https://github.com/chengyh23/PrivAct.

AI.title_translation: PrivAct：通过多智能体偏好训练实现情境隐私保护的内在化
AI.tldr: PrivAct是一个情境隐私感知的多智能体学习框架，它将情境隐私保护直接内化到大型语言模型智能体的生成行为中，以减少隐私泄露并保持实用性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地部署在涉及敏感、情境依赖信息的个性化任务中，由于情境隐私的隐含性，智能体行为中可能出现隐私侵犯。现有方法依赖于外部、推理时的干预，这些方法脆弱、特定于场景，并可能扩大隐私攻击面。
AI.method: 我们提出了PrivAct，一个情境隐私感知的多智能体学习框架，它将情境隐私保护直接内化到模型的生成行为中，以实现符合隐私的智能体行动。通过将隐私偏好嵌入到每个智能体中，PrivAct增强了系统范围内的情境完整性，同时实现了更有利的隐私-实用性权衡。
AI.result: 在多个LLM骨干和基准上的实验表明，情境隐私保护方面取得了持续改进，泄露率降低高达12.32%，同时保持了可比的实用性，并且在多样化的多智能体拓扑中表现出零样本泛化和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PrivAct通过将情境隐私保护内化到模型生成行为中，为大型语言模型智能体提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案，可以显著减少隐私泄露，同时保持任务的实用性，并在多智能体环境中表现出强大的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地部署在涉及敏感、情境依赖信息的个性化任务中，由于情境隐私的隐含性，智能体行为中可能出现隐私侵犯。现有方法依赖于外部、推理时的干预，这些方法脆弱、特定于场景，并可能扩大隐私攻击面。我们提出了PrivAct，一个情境隐私感知的多智能体学习框架，它将情境隐私保护直接内化到模型的生成行为中，以实现符合隐私的智能体行动。通过将隐私偏好嵌入到每个智能体中，PrivAct增强了系统范围内的情境完整性，同时实现了更有利的隐私-实用性权衡。在多个LLM骨干和基准上的实验表明，情境隐私保护方面取得了持续改进，泄露率降低高达12.32%，同时保持了可比的实用性，并且在多样化的多智能体拓扑中表现出零样本泛化和鲁棒性。代码可在https://github.com/chengyh23/PrivAct获取。
AI.summary: PrivAct是一个创新的多智能体学习框架，旨在解决大型语言模型智能体在个性化任务中面临的情境隐私泄露问题。它通过将隐私偏好直接嵌入到每个智能体中，内化了情境隐私保护机制，从而在不牺牲任务实用性的前提下，显著降低了隐私泄露率，并展示了良好的零样本泛化能力和多智能体拓扑的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 情境隐私, LLM智能体, 多智能体学习, 隐私保护, 偏好训练
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了将情境隐私保护内化到模型生成行为中的方法，而非依赖外部干预，这使得解决方案更加健壮和通用。其在多智能体学习框架下的应用，以及在保持实用性的同时显著降低隐私泄露率的实验结果，显示了其潜在的重要性和实用价值。

title: A Monolithic hp Space-Time Multigrid Preconditioned Newton-Krylov Solver for Space-Time FEM applied to the Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: We present a monolithic hp space-time multigrid method (hp-STMG) for tensor-product space-time finite element discretizations of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. We employ mapped inf-sup stable pairs $\mathbb Q_{r+1}/\mathbb P_{r}^{\mathrm{disc}}$ in space and a slabwise discontinuous Galerkin DG($k$) discretization in time. The resulting fully coupled nonlinear systems are solved by Newton-GMRES preconditioned with hp-STMG, combining geometric coarsening in space with polynomial coarsening in space and time. Our main contribution is an hp-robust and practically efficient extension of space-time multigrid to Navier-Stokes: matrix-free operator evaluation is retained via column-wise, state-dependent spatial kernels; the nonlinear convective term is handled by a reduced, order-preserving time quadrature. Robustness is ensured by an inexact space-time Vanka smoother based on patch models with single time point evaluation. The method is implemented in the matrix-free multigrid framework of deal.II and demonstrates h- and p-robust convergence with robust solver performance across a range of Reynolds numbers, as well as high throughput in large-scale MPI-parallel experiments.

AI.title_translation: 用于不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的时空有限元方法的单片式hp时空多重网格预处理牛顿-Krylov求解器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的、高效的、基于hp时空多重网格预处理的牛顿-Krylov求解器，用于快速求解不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的有限元离散化问题，该方法具有鲁棒性和良好的并行扩展性。
AI.motivation: 为不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的张量积时空有限元离散化，提供一个单片式、hp鲁棒且高效的时空多重网格（hp-STMG）求解器。
AI.method: 采用张量积时空有限元离散化，空间上使用映射的inf-sup稳定对 $\mathbb Q_{r+1}/\mathbb P_{r}^{\mathrm{disc}}$，时间上使用分层不连续伽辽金 DG($k$) 离散。使用hp-STMG作为预处理器，结合空间几何粗化和时空多项式粗化，通过牛顿-GMRES求解全耦合的非线性系统。矩阵无关操作通过依赖于状态的空间核进行列式评估实现，非线性对流项使用简化的保序时间积分处理。使用基于块模型的单时间点评估的不精确时空Vanka平滑器确保鲁棒性。
AI.result: 该方法在deal.II的矩阵无关多重网格框架中实现，并证明了h和p鲁棒的收敛性，以及在不同雷诺数下求解器的鲁棒性能，同时在大规模MPI并行测试中表现出高吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法（hp-STMG）在求解不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程时，展示了h和p鲁棒的收敛性以及跨越不同雷诺数的鲁棒求解器性能，并在大规模MPI并行实验中实现了高吞吐量。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程张量积时空有限元离散化的单片式hp时空多重网格方法（hp-STMG）。我们采用空间上映射的inf-sup稳定对 $\mathbb Q_{r+1}/\mathbb P_{r}^{\mathrm{disc}}$ 和时间上分层的不连续伽辽金 DG($k$) 离散。所得到的全耦合非线性系统通过牛顿-GMRES求解，并由hp-STMG预处理，该预处理结合了空间几何粗化和时空多项式粗化。我们的主要贡献是将时空多重网格对纳维-斯托克斯方程的扩展扩展到hp鲁棒且实际高效的范围：通过列式、依赖于状态的空间核保留了矩阵无关的算子评估；非线性对流项通过简化的、保序的时间积分来处理。鲁棒性由基于块模型和单时间点评估的不精确时空Vanka平滑器来保证。该方法在deal.II的矩阵无关多重网格框架中实现，并展示了h和p鲁棒的收敛性，以及跨越一系列雷诺数的鲁棒求解器性能，同时在大规模MPI并行实验中实现了高吞吐量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的单片式hp时空多重网格（hp-STMG）方法。该方法基于张量积时空有限元，结合特定的空间和时间离散格式，并利用hp-STMG作为预处理器来加速牛顿-GMRES求解器。关键创新在于保持了矩阵无关的算子评估，并设计了鲁棒的非线性处理和光滑器，实验证明了其在各种雷诺数下的鲁棒性和并行效率。
AI.keywords: hp时空多重网格, 纳维-斯托克斯方程, 有限元方法, 矩阵无关, 伽辽金方法
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于提出了一个适用于不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的单片式hp时空多重网格（hp-STMG）方法，并成功地将其扩展到非线性问题，同时保持了矩阵无关（matrix-free）的特性，展示了对雷诺数变化的鲁棒性和并行效率。局限性是摘要中未提及与现有方法的具体对比分析。

title: Automated Prediction of Paravalvular Regurgitation before Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
summary:
Severe aortic stenosis is a common and life-threatening condition in elderly patients, often treated with Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI). Despite procedural advances, paravalvular aortic regurgitation (PVR) remains one of the most frequent post-TAVI complications, with a proven impact on long-term prognosis.
  In this work, we investigate the potential of deep learning to predict the occurrence of PVR from preoperative cardiac CT. To this end, a dataset of preoperative TAVI patients was collected, and 3D convolutional neural networks were trained on isotropic CT volumes. The results achieved suggest that volumetric deep learning can capture subtle anatomical features from pre-TAVI imaging, opening new perspectives for personalized risk assessment and procedural optimization. Source code is available at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/tavi.

AI.title_translation: 经导管主动脉瓣植入术前瓣周反流的自动预测
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用3D深度学习模型分析术前CT扫描，成功预测了TAVI手术后瓣周反流的发生风险，有望用于术前风险评估。
AI.motivation: 瓣周反流（PVR）是TAVI术后最常见的并发症之一，对长期预后有明确影响，因此需要预测其发生。
AI.method: 收集了TAVI患者的术前数据集，并在各向同性的CT体积上训练了三维卷积神经网络（3D CNN）。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，体积深度学习可以从术前影像中捕获细微的解剖特征。
AI.conclusion: 体积深度学习能够从术前影像中捕获细微的解剖特征，为个性化的风险评估和手术优化开启了新的前景。
AI.translation: 严重主动脉瓣狭窄是老年患者中常见且危及生命的疾病，通常通过经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）进行治疗。尽管手术技术不断进步，瓣周反流（PVR）仍然是TAVI术后最常见的并发症之一，并对长期预后有明确影响。 在这项工作中，我们研究了利用深度学习从术前心脏CT中预测PVR发生的潜力。为此，我们收集了一个术前TAVI患者的数据集，并在各向同性的CT体积上训练了三维卷积神经网络。所取得的结果表明，体积深度学习可以从TAVI前的影像中捕获细微的解剖特征，为个性化的风险评估和手术优化开辟了新的前景。源代码可从https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/tavi获取。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在利用深度学习技术，基于术前心脏CT图像，自动预测经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）后发生瓣周反流（PVR）的风险。通过在患者的3D CT数据上训练三维卷积神经网络，研究证明了体积深度学习在识别与PVR相关的细微解剖特征方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 经导管主动脉瓣植入术, 瓣周反流, 深度学习, 计算机断层扫描, 风险预测
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于利用三维卷积神经网络直接从术前CT图像中预测TAVI术后的PVR风险，强调了体积深度学习在捕获细微解剖特征方面的潜力，为个性化风险评估开辟了新途径。其重要性在于PVR是TAVI后常见且影响预后的并发症。目前来看，该研究的局限性是未提及具体的预测性能指标（如AUC、敏感性等）。

title: Anisotropic hp space-time adaptivity and goal-oriented error control for convection-dominated problems
summary: We present an anisotropic goal-oriented error estimator based on the Dual Weighted Residual (DWR) method for time-dependent convection-dominated problems. Using elementwise p-anisotropic finite element spaces, the estimator is elementwise separated with respect to the single directions in space and time. This naturally leads to adaptive, anisotropic hp-refinement (h-anisotropic refinement and elementwise anisotropic p-enrichment). We employ discontinuous elements in space and time, which are well suited for problems with high Peclet numbers. Efficiency and robustness of the underlying algorithm are demonstrated for different goal functionals. The directional error indicators quantify anisotropy of the solution with respect to the goal, and produce hp-refinements that efficiently capture sharp layers. Numerical examples in up to three spatial dimensions demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method compared to isotropic h and hp adaptive refinement using established benchmarks for convection-dominated transport.

AI.title_translation: 对流占优问题的各向异性hp时空自适应与目标导向误差控制
AI.tldr: 针对对流占优问题，我们开发了一种新的各向异性目标导向误差估计器，它利用DWR方法和p-各向异性空间，实现了空间和时间上的解耦细化（hp-细化），能高效地捕获层流，性能优于现有各向同性方法。
AI.motivation: 针对时变对流占优问题，需要一种能够有效捕获尖锐层流（由高Peclet数引起）的自适应策略，传统的各向同性细化效率不高。
AI.method: 基于对偶加权残差（DWR）方法，提出了一种针对时变对流占优问题的各向异性目标导向误差估计器。该估计器在空间和时间上按单元方向分离，自然地导致了自适应的、各向异性的hp-细化（h-各向异性细化和单元各向异性p-加密）。在空间和时间上采用了不连续单元。
AI.result: 导出的误差指示器量化了相对于目标的解的各向异性，并产生了能够有效捕获尖锐层流的hp-细化。数值结果表明，与各向同性方法相比，该方法性能更优越。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法在不同目标泛函上展示了其效率和鲁棒性，并通过三维数值算例证明了其性能优于使用成熟基准的各向同性h和hp自适应细化方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种基于对偶加权残差（DWR）方法的、针对时变对流占优问题的各向异性目标导向误差估计器。利用单元上的p-各向异性有限元空间，该估计器在空间和时间上的单个方向上被单元wise分离。这自然地导致了自适应的、各向异性的hp-细化（h-各向异性细化和单元各向异性p-加密）。我们采用不连续单元在空间和时间上，这非常适合高Peclet数的问题。我们采用不连续单元在空间和时间上，这非常适合高Peclet数的问题。在不同的目标泛函上，底层算法的效率和鲁棒性得到了证明。方向误差指示器量化了相对于目标的解的各向异性，并产生了能够有效捕获尖锐层流的hp-细化。高达三维空间中的数值示例证明了与使用成熟基准的各向同性h和hp自适应细化相比，所提出的方法具有优越的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于DWR方法、针对时变对流占优问题的各向异性目标导向误差估计器。该估计器结合了p-各向异性有限元空间，实现了单元方向上的误差分离，从而自然地产生了自适应的、各向异性的hp-细化策略。该方法使用不连续单元，并被证明在不同目标泛函上是高效且鲁棒的，数值实验证实了其在捕获尖锐层流方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 各向异性, 目标导向误差控制, 对流占优问题, DWR方法, hp自适应细化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个基于DWR方法的、具有方向性（各向异性）的目标导向误差估计器，并将其与hp自适应网格细化相结合，特别适用于对流占优问题中捕获尖锐层流。其重要性在于提供了一种比传统各向同性方法更高效、更鲁棒的自适应策略。限制是主要集中在对流占优问题，其通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Validation for Robotic Surgery Instrument Segmentation
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive workflow for generating and validating a synthetic dataset designed for robotic surgery instrument segmentation. A 3D reconstruction of the Da Vinci robotic arms was refined and animated in Autodesk Maya through a fully automated Python-based pipeline capable of producing photorealistic, labeled video sequences. Each scene integrates randomized motion patterns, lighting variations, and synthetic blood textures to mimic intraoperative variability while preserving pixel-accurate ground truth masks. To validate the realism and effectiveness of the generated data, several segmentation models were trained under controlled ratios of real and synthetic data. Results demonstrate that a balanced composition of real and synthetic samples significantly improves model generalization compared to training on real data only, while excessive reliance on synthetic data introduces a measurable domain shift. The proposed framework provides a reproducible and scalable tool for surgical computer vision, supporting future research in data augmentation, domain adaptation, and simulation-based pretraining for robotic-assisted surgery. Data and code are available at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/Sintetic-dataset-DaVinci.

AI.title_translation: 机器人手术器械分割的合成数据集生成与验证
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个全自动流程，用于生成用于机器人手术器械分割的高质量合成数据集，并通过实验证明，平衡使用合成数据能提高模型性能，但过度依赖合成数据会导致模型泛化能力下降（领域漂移）。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决机器人手术器械分割领域中获取和标注真实数据集的困难，提供一个可扩展的解决方案来支持相关计算机视觉研究。
AI.method: 首先，通过全自动化的Python管道对Da Vinci机器人手臂的3D重建模型进行精细化处理和动画制作，生成具有随机运动、光照变化和合成血液纹理的写实视频序列，并提供像素级精确的地面真值掩码。然后，通过在不同真实/合成数据比例下训练分割模型来验证生成数据的真实性和有效性。
AI.result: 结果表明，真实与合成样本的平衡组合能显著提高模型泛化能力，优于仅使用真实数据进行训练的情况；然而，过度依赖合成数据会导致可测量的领域漂移。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架提供了一个可复现且可扩展的工具，可用于支持手术计算机视觉领域中数据增强、域适应和基于仿真的预训练等未来研究。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一个用于机器人手术器械分割的合成数据集的生成和验证的综合工作流程。通过一个完全自动化的基于Python的管道，对Da Vinci机器人手臂的3D重建模型进行了优化并在Autodesk Maya中进行了动画制作，该管道能够生成逼真的、带标签的视频序列。每个场景都集成了随机运动模式、光照变化和合成血液纹理，以模拟术中变化，同时保留了像素级精确的地面真值掩码。为了验证生成数据的真实性和有效性，我们在受控的真实和合成数据比例下训练了多个分割模型。结果表明，真实与合成样本的平衡组成相比仅用真实数据训练，能显著提高模型的泛化能力，而过度依赖合成数据会引入可测量的领域漂移。所提出的框架为手术计算机视觉提供了一个可复现和可扩展的工具，支持数据增强、域适应和基于仿真的预训练等未来研究。数据和代码可在https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/Sintetic-dataset-DaVinci获取。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种用于机器人手术器械分割的合成数据集生成与验证的全面工作流程。该流程通过全自动化的Python管道，在Autodesk Maya中生成了逼真且带有像素级精确标签的视频序列，模拟了术中变化。通过在不同真实/合成数据比例下训练模型验证了该数据集的有效性，结果显示平衡使用合成数据能提升模型泛化能力，但过度使用会导致领域漂移。该框架为手术计算机视觉研究提供了一个可扩展的工具。
AI.keywords: 合成数据生成, 机器人手术分割, 数据集验证, 领域漂移, Da Vinci机械臂
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提供了一个完全自动化的、可复现的工作流程来生成高保真的、带有像素级精确标签的机器人手术器械分割数据集，并量化了合成数据对模型泛化能力的影响，指出了过度依赖合成数据的局限性。其重要性在于解决了手术数据获取困难的问题，为机器人手术的计算机视觉研究提供了可扩展的资源。

title: Constructive Patterns for Human-Centered Tech Hiring
summary: [Context] Online Recruitment and Selection (R&S) processes are often the first point of contact between early-career software engineers and the tech industry. Yet many candidates experience these processes as opaque, inefficient, or even discouraging. While prior research has extensively documented the flaws and biases in online tech hiring, little is known about the practices that create positive candidate experiences. [Objective & Method] This paper explores such practices, referred to as Constructive Patterns (CPs), from the perspective of early-career software engineers. Guided by Applicant Attribution-Reaction Theory, we conducted 22 semi-structured interviews in which participants collectively described over 470 online R&S experiences. [Results] Through thematic analysis, we identified 22 CPs that reflect positive practices such as comprehensive and transparent job advertisements (CP01), specific and developmental feedback (CP03), humanized and respectful interaction (CP06), and framing the process as a two-way street (CP18). [Conclusion] Our findings extend the conversation on tech hiring beyond diagnosing dysfunctions toward designing for human-centered and growth-oriented candidate experiences. The resulting catalog of CPs provides a concrete and empirically grounded resource for organizations seeking to attract and support early-career software engineers more effectively.

AI.title_translation: 面向人机交互技术招聘的建设性模式
AI.tldr: 研究通过访谈早期职业软件工程师，总结了22种在在线招聘中能带来积极体验的“建设性模式”（CPs），如透明公告和发展性反馈，为技术公司优化招聘流程提供了具体指导。
AI.motivation: 在线招聘和选拔过程对早期职业软件工程师来说往往是模糊、效率低下甚至令人气馁的。尽管已有研究记录了在线技术招聘中的缺陷和偏见，但关于创造积极候选人体验的做法（即建设性模式）的研究却很少。
AI.method: 基于申请人归因反应理论（Applicant Attribution-Reaction Theory），进行了22次半结构化访谈，参与者共描述了470多个在线招聘和甄选（R&S）经历，并通过主题分析识别出建设性模式（CPs）。
AI.result: 通过主题分析，识别出22个CPs，反映了积极的做法，例如全面透明的职位广告（CP01）、具体且具有发展性的反馈（CP03）、人性化和尊重的互动（CP06）以及将流程定位为双向交流（CP18）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将技术招聘的讨论从诊断功能障碍扩展到为以人为本和以成长为导向的候选人体验进行设计。由此产生的CPs目录为寻求更有效地吸引和支持早期职业软件工程师的组织提供了一个具体且有实证基础的资源。
AI.translation: [背景] 在线招聘和选拔（R&S）流程通常是早期职业软件工程师与科技行业接触的第一站。然而，许多候选人认为这些流程是模糊、效率低下甚至令人气馁的。虽然现有研究已广泛记录了在线技术招聘中的缺陷和偏见，但关于创造积极候选人体验的做法知之甚少。[目标与方法] 本文从早期职业软件工程师的角度探讨了这些被称为“建设性模式”（CPs）的做法。在申请人归因反应理论的指导下，我们对22人进行了半结构化访谈，参与者共描述了470多次在线R&S经历。[结果] 通过主题分析，我们确定了22个CPs，反映了积极的做法，例如全面透明的职位广告（CP01）、具体和具有发展性的反馈（CP03）、人性化和尊重的互动（CP06）以及将流程定位为双向交流（CP18）。[结论] 我们的研究结果将技术招聘的讨论从诊断功能障碍扩展到为以人为本和以成长为导向的候选人体验进行设计。由此产生的CPs目录为寻求更有效地吸引和支持早期职业软件工程师的组织提供了一个具体且有实证基础的资源。
AI.summary: 本文旨在探讨早期职业软件工程师认为积极的在线招聘和选拔实践，即“建设性模式”（CPs）。通过对22位工程师的访谈分析，研究识别出22个CPs，涵盖了透明的广告、有建设性的反馈和人性化的互动等方面，旨在为组织提供设计以人为本、以成长为导向的招聘流程的实证资源。
AI.keywords: 技术招聘, 候选人体验, 建设性模式, 在线甄选, 早期职业工程师
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于从候选人视角系统地总结了“建设性模式”（CPs），将研究重点从仅仅诊断技术招聘中的问题转向主动设计以改善候选人体验。其重要性在于提供了一个实证支持的、可操作的资源，帮助组织吸引和支持早期职业软件工程师。局限性可能在于研究仅基于早期职业工程师的经验，可能无法完全概括所有技术职位的招聘情况。

title: Cardiac Output Prediction from Echocardiograms: Self-Supervised Learning with Limited Data
summary: Cardiac Output (CO) is a key parameter in the diagnosis and management of cardiovascular diseases. However, its accurate measurement requires right-heart catheterization, an invasive and time-consuming procedure, motivating the development of reliable non-invasive alternatives using echocardiography. In this work, we propose a self-supervised learning (SSL) pretraining strategy based on SimCLR to improve CO prediction from apical four-chamber echocardiographic videos. The pretraining is performed using the same limited dataset available for the downstream task, demonstrating the potential of SSL even under data scarcity. Our results show that SSL mitigates overfitting and improves representation learning, achieving an average Pearson correlation of 0.41 on the test set and outperforming PanEcho, a model trained on over one million echocardiographic exams. Source code is available at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/cardiac-output.

AI.title_translation: 心脏搏出量从超声心动图预测：有限数据下的自监督学习
AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于SimCLR的自监督学习（SSL）预训练策略，用于从超声心动图视频预测心脏搏出量（CO）。该方法在有限数据集上进行预训练，并证明了SSL在数据稀缺情况下的潜力。结果显示，SSL能减轻过拟合，改善表示学习，在测试集上达到0.41的平均皮尔逊相关系数，并优于在大量超声心动图检查上训练的PanEcho模型。
AI.motivation: 准确测量心脏搏出量（CO）需要侵入性的右心导管插入术，因此需要开发可靠的非侵入性替代方法，例如使用超声心动图。
AI.method: 使用基于SimCLR的自监督学习（SSL）预训练策略，对同一有限数据集进行预训练，然后用于下游任务（CO预测）。
AI.result: SSL预训练减轻了过拟合，改善了表示学习，在测试集上实现了0.41的平均皮尔逊相关系数，并且优于PanEcho模型。
AI.conclusion: 自监督学习（SSL）预训练策略能够有效地提高从超声心动图预测心脏搏出量的性能，尤其是在数据量有限的情况下，通过改善表示学习和减轻过拟合。
AI.translation: 心脏搏出量（CO）是心血管疾病诊断和管理中的一个关键参数。然而，其准确测量需要右心导管插入术，这是一种侵入性和耗时性程序，促使人们开发使用超声心动图的可靠的非侵入性替代方法。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于SimCLR的自监督学习（SSL）预训练策略，以提高从心尖四腔超声心动图视频预测CO的性能。预训练使用与下游任务相同的数据集，证明了SSL在数据稀缺情况下的潜力。我们的结果表明，SSL减轻了过拟合并改善了表示学习，在测试集上实现了0.41的平均皮尔逊相关系数，并且优于在超过一百万次超声心动图检查上训练的PanEcho模型。源代码可在https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/cardiac-output获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用自监督学习（SSL）和SimCLR框架，从超声心动图视频预测心脏搏出量（CO）的方法。该方法在有限的数据集上进行预训练，旨在克服数据稀缺的挑战，并有效提升模型的表示学习能力，减轻过拟合。实验结果表明，该SSL方法在测试集上取得了0.41的平均皮尔逊相关系数，性能优于在海量数据上训练的PanEcho模型。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 心脏搏出量, 超声心动图, SimCLR, 表示学习
AI.comments: 这项研究展示了自监督学习在医疗影像分析中的潜力，特别是在数据量有限的情况下。通过利用SimCLR框架进行预训练，模型能够学习到更有意义的特征表示，从而提高心脏搏出量预测的准确性。然而，0.41的皮尔逊相关系数表明仍有很大的提升空间，未来的研究可以探索更先进的SSL技术或结合其他模态信息来进一步提高预测精度。

title: Testing For Distribution Shifts with Conditional Conformal Test Martingales
summary:
We propose a sequential test for detecting arbitrary distribution shifts that allows conformal test martingales (CTMs) to work under a fixed, reference-conditional setting. Existing CTM detectors construct test martingales by continually growing a reference set with each incoming sample, using it to assess how atypical the new sample is relative to past observations. While this design yields anytime-valid type-I error control, it suffers from test-time contamination: after a change, post-shift observations enter the reference set and dilute the evidence for distribution shift, increasing detection delay and reducing power.
  In contrast, our method avoids contamination by design by comparing each new sample to a fixed null reference dataset. Our main technical contribution is a robust martingale construction that remains valid conditional on the null reference data, achieved by explicitly accounting for the estimation error in the reference distribution induced by the finite reference set. This yields anytime-valid type-I error control together with guarantees of asymptotic power one and bounded expected detection delay. Empirically, our method detects shifts faster than standard CTMs, providing a powerful and reliable distribution-shift detector.

AI.title_translation: 检测条件共形检验鞅的分布偏移
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新的序列检测分布偏移的方法，通过使用固定的参考数据集避免了传统方法的污染问题，从而提高了检测速度和功效。
AI.motivation: 现有条件共形检验鞅（CTMs）在检测分布偏移时存在测试时间污染问题，即变化发生后，新的样本会污染参考集，导致检测延迟和功效降低。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的序列检测方法，通过将新样本与固定的、未污染的参考数据集进行比较来避免污染。通过构建一个鲁棒的鞅，显式地考虑了由于有限参考集引起的参考分布的估计误差，从而在固定参考数据集的条件下保持有效性。
AI.result: 该方法实现了任何时候都有效的I类错误控制，同时保证了渐进功效为一和有界的期望检测延迟。实验结果表明，该方法比标准的CTMs能更快地检测到偏移。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种强大且可靠的分布偏移检测器，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在实际应用中表现出更快的检测速度。
AI.translation:
我们提出了一种用于检测任意分布偏移的序列检验方法，该方法允许条件共形检验鞅（CTMs）在固定的、参考条件设置下工作。现有的CTM检测器通过不断地用每个新输入的样本来扩展参考集来构建检验鞅，并利用它来评估新样本相对于过去观测的异常程度。虽然这种设计能够随时有效地控制I类错误，但它存在测试时间污染的问题：在发生变化后，后移的观测会进入参考集，稀释分布偏移的证据，从而增加检测延迟并降低功效。
相比之下，我们的方法通过将每个新样本与固定的零假设参考数据集进行比较，从设计上避免了污染。我们的主要技术贡献是构建了一个鲁棒的鞅，它通过显式地考虑由有限参考集引起的参考分布的估计误差，在条件上对零假设参考数据保持有效。这实现了任何时候都有效的I类错误控制，同时保证了渐进功效为一和有界的期望检测延迟。在经验上，我们的方法比标准的CTMs能更快地检测到偏移，提供了一种强大且可靠的分布偏移检测器。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的条件共形检验鞅（CTM）方法，用于检测分布偏移。与现有方法不同，该方法使用固定的参考数据集，避免了因新样本污染参考集而导致的检测延迟和功效下降问题。通过构建一个鲁棒的鞅，该方法在条件上对参考数据保持有效，实现了任意时间有效的I类错误控制、渐进功效一和有界的期望检测延迟。实验结果证实，该方法比标准CTM能更快速地检测到分布偏移。
AI.keywords: 分布偏移, 条件共形检验鞅, 序列检验, 参考集污染, 鲁棒鞅
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种有前景的分布偏移检测方法，通过巧妙地设计避免了现有方法的关键缺陷。固定参考集的设计是一个重要的创新，解决了测试时间污染问题。鲁棒鞅的构建及其理论保证（包括渐进功效一和有界的期望检测延迟）是该研究的亮点。然而，对于实际应用中的计算复杂性以及该方法在不同类型和规模的偏移上的泛化能力，可以进行进一步的探讨。

title: Push-Placement: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Prehensile and Non-Prehensile Manipulation for Object Rearrangement
comments: International Conference on Robotics and Mechatronics (ICRoM 2025)
summary: Efficient tabletop rearrangement remains challenging due to collisions and the need for temporary buffering when target poses are obstructed. Prehensile pick-and-place provides precise control but often requires extra moves, whereas non-prehensile pushing can be more efficient but suffers from complex, imprecise dynamics. This paper proposes push-placement, a hybrid action primitive that uses the grasped object to displace obstructing items while being placed, thereby reducing explicit buffering. The method is integrated into a physics-in-the-loop Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) planner and evaluated in the PyBullet simulator. Empirical results show push-placement reduces the manipulator travel cost by up to 11.12% versus a baseline MCTS planner and 8.56% versus dynamic stacking. These findings indicate that hybrid prehensile/non-prehensile action primitives can substantially improve efficiency in long-horizon rearrangement tasks.
comment: International Conference on Robotics and Mechatronics (ICRoM 2025)

AI.title_translation: 推-放置：一种整合预抓取和非预抓取操作的混合方法，用于物体重排
AI.tldr: 为了提高机器人桌面重排的效率，我们提出了一种“推-放置”混合动作，它在放置物体时顺便用它来推开障碍物，从而避免了额外的缓冲步骤。实验证明，这种方法比传统方法能节省高达11%的移动距离。
AI.motivation: 桌面重排任务具有挑战性，主要源于碰撞以及目标姿态受阻时需要临时缓冲的需求。现有的预抓取操作控制精确但需要额外移动，而非抓取推动效率更高但动力学复杂且不精确。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“推-放置”（push-placement）的混合动作原语，该原语在放置被抓取物体时，利用该物体来移动遮挡物。该方法被集成到一个物理闭环的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）规划器中进行评估。
AI.result: 与基线MCTS规划器相比，推-放置将机械臂的移动成本降低了高达11.12%；与动态堆叠相比，降低了8.56%。
AI.conclusion: 混合的抓取/非抓取动作原语可以显著提高长期重排任务的效率。
AI.translation: 高效的桌面重排仍然具有挑战性，因为存在碰撞，并且在目标姿态受阻时需要临时缓冲。预抓取式抓取和放置提供了精确的控制，但通常需要额外的移动，而无抓取式推动可以更有效，但存在复杂、不精确的动力学问题。本文提出了一种混合动作原语——推-放置（push-placement），它在放置被抓取物体时，利用该物体来移动遮挡物，从而减少显式的缓冲操作。该方法被集成到一个物理闭环的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）规划器中，并在PyBullet模拟器中进行了评估。实证结果表明，与基线MCTS规划器相比，推-放置将机械臂的移动成本降低了高达11.12%；与动态堆叠相比，降低了8.56%。这些发现表明，混合的预抓取/非预抓取动作原语可以显著提高长期重排任务的效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“推-放置”的混合动作原语，它结合了预抓取和非预抓取操作，通过在放置目标物体时利用其推动遮挡物，以减少重排任务中的显式缓冲需求。该方法集成到MCTS规划器中，并在模拟器中证明可显著降低移动成本。
AI.keywords: 物体重排, 混合操作, 推-放置, 预抓取操作, 蒙特卡洛树搜索
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于将精细的抓取操作与高效的非抓取推动操作相结合，以解决物体重排中的碰撞和缓冲问题。这对于提高机器人操作的效率和实用性具有重要意义。限制在于评估仅在PyBullet模拟器中进行，其实际泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: Humanoid Hanoi: Investigating Shared Whole-Body Control for Skill-Based Box Rearrangement
summary: We investigate a skill-based framework for humanoid box rearrangement that enables long-horizon execution by sequencing reusable skills at the task level. In our architecture, all skills execute through a shared, task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC), providing a consistent closed-loop interface for skill composition, in contrast to non-shared designs that use separate low-level controllers per skill. We find that naively reusing the same pretrained WBC can reduce robustness over long horizons, as new skills and their compositions induce shifted state and command distributions. We address this with a simple data aggregation procedure that augments shared-WBC training with rollouts from closed-loop skill execution under domain randomization. To evaluate the approach, we introduce \emph{Humanoid Hanoi}, a long-horizon Tower-of-Hanoi box rearrangement benchmark, and report results in simulation and on the Digit V3 humanoid robot, demonstrating fully autonomous rearrangement over extended horizons and quantifying the benefits of the shared-WBC approach over non-shared baselines.

AI.title_translation: 人形Hanoi：研究基于技能的箱体重新排列的共享全身控制
AI.tldr: 研究人员为人形机器人设计了一个新的技能框架，所有技能都使用同一个全身控制器（WBC）来完成箱体重新排列的长期任务。他们发现直接重用WBC会导致性能下降，因此设计了一种数据增强方法来训练共享WBC，并在模拟和真实机器人上成功展示了完全自主的长期操作，证明了共享控制的优势。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在开发一个技能驱动的框架，用于人形机器人的长期箱体重新排列任务，通过序列化可重用的技能来实现。与使用单独低级控制器的非共享设计不同，该框架旨在通过一个共享的、任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）提供一致的闭环接口来进行技能组合。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于共享、任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）的技能框架，通过在任务级别对可重用技能进行排序来实现长期执行。通过一种简单的数据聚合程序来增强共享WBC的训练，该过程使用领域随机化下闭环技能执行的滚转数据来解决鲁棒性下降问题。
AI.result: 发现天真地重用预训练的WBC会降低长期鲁棒性。通过数据聚合程序增强训练后，在模拟和真实的Digit V3人形机器人上，实现了完全自主的长时间重新排列，并证明了共享WBC方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了在模拟和真实的Digit V3人形机器人上，通过共享WBC方法实现了长时间内完全自主的箱体重新排列，并量化了其相对于非共享基线的优势。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一种用于人形机器人箱体重新排列的基于技能的框架，该框架通过在任务级别对可重用的技能进行排序来实现长期执行。在我们的架构中，所有技能都通过一个共享的、与任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）执行，为技能组合提供了一致的闭环接口，这与为每个技能使用单独的低级控制器的非共享设计形成了对比。我们发现，天真地重用相同的预训练WBC会降低长期鲁棒性，因为新的技能及其组合会引起状态和命令分布的偏移。我们通过一种简单的数据聚合程序来解决这个问题，该程序通过领域随机化下闭环技能执行的滚转数据来增强共享WBC的训练。为了评估该方法，我们引入了\emph{人形Hanoi}，这是一个长期的汉诺塔箱体重新排列基准测试，并在模拟和Digit V3人形机器人上报告了结果，展示了在扩展的视野内完全自主的重新排列，并量化了共享WBC方法相对于非共享基线的优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于人形机器人箱体重新排列任务的基于技能的框架，该框架通过一个共享的、任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）来执行可重用的技能序列，以实现长期任务。为解决共享WBC在长期执行中因状态和命令分布偏移而导致的鲁棒性下降问题，研究引入了一种数据聚合训练策略。通过在新的“人形Hanoi”基准测试中进行评估，结果表明该方法在模拟和真实机器人上均能实现完全自主的长期重新排列，并优于非共享基线。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 全身控制, 技能组合, 任务规划, 箱体重新排列
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个基于共享的、与任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）的技能框架，用于人形机器人的长期箱体重新排列任务。其重要性在于提供了一种一致的闭环接口来实现技能组合，并解决了共享WBC在长期执行中鲁棒性下降的问题。局限性可能在于其数据聚合过程的有效性在更复杂的任务中可能需要进一步验证。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated ACSL Annotations for Formal Verification
comments: 12 pages. Submitted to Formal Techniques for Judicious Programming FTfJP-2026 at ECOOP. Under review
summary: Formal specifications are crucial for building verifiable and dependable software systems, yet generating accurate and verifiable specifications for real-world C programs remains challenging. This paper empirically evaluates the extent to which formal-analysis tools can automatically generate and verify ACSL specifications without human or learning-based assistance. We conduct a controlled study on a recently released dataset of 506 C programs, repurposing it from interactive, developer-driven workflows to an automated evaluation setting. Five ACSL generation systems are compared: a rule-based Python script, Frama-C's RTE plugin, and three large language models--DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.2, and OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct. All generated specifications are verified under identical conditions using the Frama-C WP plugin powered by multiple SMT solvers, allowing a direct comparison of annotation quality, solver sensitivity, and proof stability. Our results provide new empirical evidence on the capabilities and limitations of automated ACSL generation, complementing prior survey-based work.

AI.title_translation: 评估LLM生成的ACSL注解在形式验证中的应用
AI.tldr: 该研究评估了五种自动生成ACSL注解的系统（包括三种大型语言模型）在形式验证中的表现，发现它们在处理真实C程序时各有优劣，为自动化注解生成提供了实证依据。
AI.motivation: 为真实世界的C程序生成准确且可验证的形式规约（ACSL注解）仍然是一个挑战，需要自动化方法来辅助。
AI.method: 在包含506个C程序的公开数据集中，对五种ACSL生成系统（基于规则的Python脚本、Frama-C的RTE插件、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2和OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct）进行了自动评估。所有生成的注解均在相同条件下使用Frama-C WP插件和SMT求解器进行验证。
AI.result: 研究提供了关于自动化ACSL生成能力和局限性的新实证证据，并对不同系统的注解质量、求解器敏感度和证明稳定性进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 自动化ACSL注解生成在形式验证方面具有潜力，但仍面临挑战，需要进一步的研究来提高其准确性和可靠性。
AI.translation: 形式规约对于构建可验证和可靠的软件系统至关重要，但为现实世界的C程序生成准确且可验证的规约仍然具有挑战性。本文实证评估了形式分析工具在没有人工或基于学习的辅助下自动生成和验证ACSL规约的程度。我们在最近发布的506个C程序的数据集上进行了一项受控研究，将其从交互式、开发人员驱动的工作流重新用于自动化评估设置。比较了五种ACSL生成系统：一个基于规则的Python脚本，Frama-C的RTE插件，以及三种大型语言模型——DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2和OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct。所有生成的规约都在相同的条件下使用由多个SMT求解器支持的Frama-C WP插件进行验证，从而可以直接比较注解质量、求解器敏感度和证明稳定性。我们的结果为自动化ACSL生成的 C apabilities和局限性提供了新的实证证据，补充了先前基于调查的工作。
AI.summary: 本研究通过在506个C程序的公开数据集上进行实证评估，比较了五种自动生成ACSL注解的系统（包括三种大型语言模型：DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2和OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct，以及一个基于规则的Python脚本和Frama-C的RTE插件）在形式验证中的表现。所有生成的注解均在相同条件下使用Frama-C WP插件和SMT求解器进行验证，旨在直接比较注解质量、求解器敏感度和证明稳定性，为自动化ACSL生成的能力和局限性提供新的实证证据。
AI.keywords: ACSL注解,形式验证,大型语言模型,自动化规约生成,C程序
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证方法评估了不同自动化工具（特别是大型语言模型）生成ACSL注解在形式验证方面的能力，为该领域的研究提供了有价值的基准数据和见解。研究设计严谨，通过统一的验证环境确保了结果的可比性。然而，研究结果也凸显了当前自动化工具的局限性，表明在完全取代人工标注或实现高精度自动验证方面仍有很长的路要走。未来的工作可以进一步探索如何结合不同工具的优势，或利用更先进的机器学习技术来提高注解的生成质量和验证的成功率。

title: Experimentation Accelerator: Interpretable Insights and Creative Recommendations for A/B Testing with Content-Aware ranking
summary: Modern online experimentation faces two bottlenecks: scarce traffic forces tough choices on which variants to test, and post-hoc insight extraction is manual, inconsistent, and often content-agnostic. Meanwhile, organizations underuse historical A/B results and rich content embeddings that could guide prioritization and creative iteration. We present a unified framework to (i) prioritize which variants to test, (ii) explain why winners win, and (iii) surface targeted opportunities for new, higher-potential variants. Leveraging treatment embeddings and historical outcomes, we train a CTR ranking model with fixed effects for contextual shifts that scores candidates while balancing value and content diversity. For better interpretability and understanding, we project treatments onto curated semantic marketing attributes and re-express the ranker in this space via a sign-consistent, sparse constrained Lasso, yielding per-attribute coefficients and signed contributions for visual explanations, top-k drivers, and natural-language insights. We then compute an opportunity index combining attribute importance (from the ranker) with under-expression in the current experiment to flag missing, high-impact attributes. Finally, LLMs translate ranked opportunities into concrete creative suggestions and estimate both learning and conversion potential, enabling faster, more informative, and more efficient test cycles. These components have been built into a real Adobe product, called \textit{Experimentation Accelerator}, to provide AI-based insights and opportunities to scale experimentation for customers. We provide an evaluation of the performance of the proposed framework on some real-world experiments by Adobe business customers that validate the high quality of the generation pipeline.

AI.title_translation: 实验加速器：用于 A/B 测试的可解释见解和创意推荐，具有内容感知排名
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为“实验加速器”的框架，旨在解决在线 A/B 测试中的流量限制和洞察提取瓶颈。该框架利用治疗嵌入和历史结果，通过内容感知排名模型来优先选择测试变体，解释获胜原因，并提出新的高潜力变体建议。它还通过将治疗效果映射到语义营销属性，并利用 Lasso 回归实现可解释性，从而提供每种属性的系数和贡献。此外，该框架通过计算机会指数来识别当前实验中未充分表达但具有高影响力的属性，并利用大型语言模型将这些机会转化为具体的创意建议，预估其学习和转化潜力，以加速和优化测试周期。该框架已集成到 Adobe 的产品中，并在实际客户实验中得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 在线实验面临流量限制导致的测试选择困难，以及手动、不一致且内容无关的洞察提取问题。此外，组织往往未能充分利用历史 A/B 测试结果和内容嵌入来指导优先级排序和创意迭代。
AI.method: 该框架首先利用治疗嵌入和历史结果训练一个点击率（CTR）排名模型，该模型包含固定效应以适应上下文变化，从而在价值和内容多样性之间取得平衡来对候选变体进行评分。为了提高可解释性，该框架将治疗效果投影到预先定义的语义营销属性上，并通过带有符号一致性和稀疏约束的 Lasso 回归模型重新表达排名器。这使得能够获得每种属性的系数和符号贡献，用于可视化解释、前 K 个驱动因素分析和自然语言洞察。然后，通过结合排名器得出的属性重要性以及在当前实验中表达不足的情况，计算出一个机会指数，以标记缺失但具有高影响力属性的领域。最后，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）将排名后的机会转化为具体的创意建议，并估算其学习和转化潜力。
AI.result: 该框架能够优先选择测试变体，解释获胜原因，并提出新的高潜力变体建议。通过将治疗效果映射到语义营销属性，并利用 Lasso 回归，可以获得每种属性的系数和贡献，从而实现可视化解释、驱动因素分析和自然语言洞察。机会指数能够识别当前实验中未充分表达但具有高影响力属性的领域。大型语言模型（LLMs）能够将这些机会转化为具体的创意建议，并预估其学习和转化潜力。该框架已成功集成到 Adobe 的产品中，并在实际客户实验中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过内容感知排名、可解释的属性分析和 LLM 驱动的创意建议，能够显著加速和优化在线实验的测试周期，提高效率和信息量。该框架已成功应用于实际产品，并在客户实验中得到验证。
AI.translation: 现代在线实验面临两大瓶颈：稀缺的流量迫使我们在测试哪些变体时做出艰难的选择，以及事后洞察提取是手动、不一致且通常与内容无关的。与此同时，组织未能充分利用历史 A/B 结果和丰富的内容嵌入，而这些本可以指导优先级排序和创意迭代。我们提出了一个统一的框架来 (i) 确定要测试的变体优先级，(ii) 解释获胜的原因，以及 (iii) 挖掘新的、更高潜力变体的目标机会。利用治疗嵌入和历史结果，我们训练了一个点击率（CTR）排名模型，其中包含用于上下文变化的固定效应，该模型在平衡价值和内容多样性的同时对候选者进行评分。为了获得更好的可解释性和理解，我们将治疗效果投影到精心策划的语义营销属性上，并通过一种符号一致的、稀疏约束的 Lasso 回归模型在该空间中重新表达排名器，从而产生每种属性的系数和符号贡献，用于可视化解释、前 K 个驱动因素和自然语言洞察。然后，我们计算一个机会指数，结合了属性重要性（来自排名器）和当前实验中的低表达度，以标记缺失的、高影响力的属性。最后，大型语言模型（LLMs）将排名后的机会转化为具体的创意建议，并估算学习和转化潜力，从而实现更快、更具信息量、更高效的测试周期。这些组件已被构建到 Adobe 的一款名为“实验加速器”的实际产品中，为客户提供基于 AI 的见解和机会，以扩展实验能力。我们提供了对该框架在 Adobe 业务客户的一些真实世界实验中的性能评估，验证了生成管道的高质量。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“实验加速器”的统一框架，旨在解决在线 A/B 测试中的流量限制和洞察提取瓶颈。该框架通过内容感知排名模型，利用治疗嵌入和历史结果，对候选变体进行优先级排序，并解释获胜原因。通过将治疗效果映射到语义营销属性并使用稀疏约束 Lasso 回归，实现了可解释性，能够识别关键驱动因素和提供自然语言洞察。此外，框架通过机会指数识别未充分利用但具有高潜力的属性，并利用大型语言模型生成具体的创意建议，预估其影响。该框架已集成到 Adobe 产品中，并在实际客户实验中得到了验证，能够加速和优化实验流程。
AI.keywords: A/B 测试, 实验加速器, 内容感知排名, 可解释性, 创意推荐
AI.comments: 该研究提出的“实验加速器”框架在解决在线 A/B 测试的实际痛点方面具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将内容感知排名、可解释性分析和 LLM 驱动的创意生成相结合，形成了一个端到端的解决方案。通过将抽象的治疗效果转化为具体的营销属性和可操作的创意建议，极大地降低了实验分析的门槛，并有望提高实验的效率和效果。将该框架集成到实际产品中是其价值的有力证明。未来的工作可以进一步探索更复杂的模型来捕捉治疗效果与内容之间的细微关系，以及评估该框架在不同业务场景下的长期影响。

title: From Fluent to Verifiable: Claim-Level Auditability for Deep Research Agents
summary: A deep research agent produces a fluent scientific report in minutes; a careful reader then tries to verify the main claims and discovers the real cost is not reading, but tracing: which sentence is supported by which passage, what was ignored, and where evidence conflicts. We argue that as research generation becomes cheap, auditability becomes the bottleneck, and the dominant risk shifts from isolated factual errors to scientifically styled outputs whose claim-evidence links are weak, missing, or misleading. This perspective proposes claim-level auditability as a first-class design and evaluation target for deep research agents, distills recurring long-horizon failure modes (objective drift, transient constraints, and unverifiable inference), and introduces the Auditable Autonomous Research (AAR) standard, a compact measurement framework that makes auditability testable via provenance coverage, provenance soundness, contradiction transparency, and audit effort. We then argue for semantic provenance with protocolized validation: persistent, queryable provenance graphs that encode claim--evidence relations (including conflicts) and integrate continuous validation during synthesis rather than after publication, with practical instrumentation patterns to support deployment at scale.

title: sleep2vec: Unified Cross-Modal Alignment for Heterogeneous Nocturnal Biosignals
summary: Tasks ranging from sleep staging to clinical diagnosis traditionally rely on standard polysomnography (PSG) devices, bedside monitors and wearable devices, which capture diverse nocturnal biosignals (e.g., EEG, EOG, ECG, SpO$_2$). However, heterogeneity across devices and frequent sensor dropout pose significant challenges for unified modelling of these multimodal signals. We present \texttt{sleep2vec}, a foundation model for diverse and incomplete nocturnal biosignals that learns a shared representation via cross-modal alignment. \texttt{sleep2vec} is contrastively pre-trained on 42,249 overnight recordings spanning nine modalities using a \textit{Demography, Age, Site \& History-aware InfoNCE} objective that incorporates physiological and acquisition metadata (\textit{e.g.}, age, gender, recording site) to dynamically weight negatives and mitigate cohort-specific shortcuts. On downstream sleep staging and clinical outcome assessment, \texttt{sleep2vec} consistently outperforms strong baselines and remains robust to any subset of available modalities and sensor dropout. We further characterize, to our knowledge for the first time, scaling laws for nocturnal biosignals with respect to modality diversity and model capacity. Together, these results show that unified cross-modal alignment, coupled with principled scaling, enables label-efficient, general-purpose modelling of real-world nocturnal biosignals.

title: Low-Pass Filtering Improves Behavioral Alignment of Vision Models
summary:
Despite their impressive performance on computer vision benchmarks, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) still fall short of adequately modeling human visual behavior, as measured by error consistency and shape bias. Recent work hypothesized that behavioral alignment can be drastically improved through \emph{generative} -- rather than \emph{discriminative} -- classifiers, with far-reaching implications for models of human vision.
  Here, we instead show that the increased alignment of generative models can be largely explained by a seemingly innocuous resizing operation in the generative model which effectively acts as a low-pass filter. In a series of controlled experiments, we show that removing high-frequency spatial information from discriminative models like CLIP drastically increases their behavioral alignment. Simply blurring images at test-time -- rather than training on blurred images -- achieves a new state-of-the-art score on the model-vs-human benchmark, halving the current alignment gap between DNNs and human observers. Furthermore, low-pass filters are likely optimal, which we demonstrate by directly optimizing filters for alignment. To contextualize the performance of optimal filters, we compute the frontier of all possible pareto-optimal solutions to the benchmark, which was formerly unknown.
  We explain our findings by observing that the frequency spectrum of optimal Gaussian filters roughly matches the spectrum of band-pass filters implemented by the human visual system. We show that the contrast sensitivity function, describing the inverse of the contrast threshold required for humans to detect a sinusoidal grating as a function of spatiotemporal frequency, is approximated well by Gaussian filters of the specific width that also maximizes error consistency.

title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise, and Safe
comments: Accepted to the PhD Symposium at Web Conference 2026
summary: The overarching research direction of this work is the development of a ''Responsible Intelligence'' framework designed to reconcile the immense generative power of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the stringent requirements of real-world deployment. As these models become a transformative force in artificial intelligence, there is an urgent need to move beyond general-purpose architectures toward systems that are contextually aware, inherently safer, and deeply respectful of global cultural nuances. This research navigates three interconnected threads: domain adaptation to ensure technical precision, ethical rigor to mitigate adversarial vulnerabilities, and cultural/multilingual alignment to promote global inclusivity. The methodological trajectory moves from classical supervised adaptation for task-specific demands to decoding-time alignment for safety, finally leveraging human feedback and preference modeling to achieve sociolinguistic acuity.
comment: Accepted to the PhD Symposium at Web Conference 2026

title: Min-Max Connected Multiway Cut
summary:
We introduce a variant of the multiway cut that we call the min-max connected multiway cut. Given a graph $G=(V,E)$ and a set $Γ\subseteq V$ of $t$ terminals, partition $V$ into $t$ parts such that each part is connected and contains exactly one terminal; the objective is to minimize the maximum weight of the edges leaving any part of the partition. This problem is a natural modification of the standard multiway cut problem and it differs from it in two ways: first, the cost of a partition is defined to be the maximum size of the boundary of any part, as opposed to the sum of all boundaries, and second, the subgraph induced by each part is required to be connected. Although the modified objective function has been considered before in the literature under the name min-max multiway cut, the requirement on each component to be connected has not been studied as far as we know.
  We show various hardness results for this problem, including a proof of weak NP-hardness of the weighted version of the problem on graphs with tree-width two, and provide a pseudopolynomial time algorithm as well as an FPTAS for the weighted problem on trees. As a consequence of our investigation we also show that the (unconstrained) min-max multiway cut problem is NP-hard even for three terminals, strengthening the known results.

title: Evolving Multi-Channel Confidence-Aware Activation Functions for Missing Data with Channel Propagation
summary: Learning in the presence of missing data can result in biased predictions and poor generalizability, among other difficulties, which data imputation methods only partially address. In neural networks, activation functions significantly affect performance yet typical options (e.g., ReLU, Swish) operate only on feature values and do not account for missingness indicators or confidence scores. We propose Three-Channel Evolved Activations (3C-EA), which we evolve using Genetic Programming to produce multivariate activation functions f(x, m, c) in the form of trees that take (i) the feature value x, (ii) a missingness indicator m, and (iii) an imputation confidence score c. To make these activations useful beyond the input layer, we introduce ChannelProp, an algorithm that deterministically propagates missingness and confidence values via linear layers based on weight magnitudes, retaining reliability signals throughout the network. We evaluate 3C-EA and ChannelProp on datasets with natural and injected (MCAR/MAR/MNAR) missingness at multiple rates under identical preprocessing and splits. Results indicate that integrating missingness and confidence inputs into the activation search improves classification performance under missingness.

title: Enabling Option Learning in Sparse Rewards with Hindsight Experience Replay
summary: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) frameworks like Option-Critic (OC) and Multi-updates Option Critic (MOC) have introduced significant advancements in learning reusable options. However, these methods underperform in multi-goal environments with sparse rewards, where actions must be linked to temporally distant outcomes. To address this limitation, we first propose MOC-HER, which integrates the Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) mechanism into the MOC framework. By relabeling goals from achieved outcomes, MOC-HER can solve sparse reward environments that are intractable for the original MOC. However, this approach is insufficient for object manipulation tasks, where the reward depends on the object reaching the goal rather than on the agent's direct interaction. This makes it extremely difficult for HRL agents to discover how to interact with these objects. To overcome this issue, we introduce Dual Objectives Hindsight Experience Replay (2HER), a novel extension that creates two sets of virtual goals. In addition to relabeling goals based on the object's final state (standard HER), 2HER also generates goals from the agent's effector positions, rewarding the agent for both interacting with the object and completing the task. Experimental results in robotic manipulation environments show that MOC-2HER achieves success rates of up to 90%, compared to less than 11% for both MOC and MOC-HER. These results highlight the effectiveness of our dual objective relabeling strategy in sparse reward, multi-goal tasks.

title: Modeling and Optimizing the Provisioning of Exhaustible Capabilities for Simultaneous Task Allocation and Scheduling
summary: Deploying heterogeneous robot teams to accomplish multiple tasks over extended time horizons presents significant computational challenges for task allocation and planning. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, time-extended, offline heterogeneous multi-robot task allocation framework, TRAITS, which we believe to be the first that can cope with the provisioning of exhaustible traits under battery and temporal constraints. Specifically, we introduce a nonlinear programming-based trait distribution module that can optimize the trait-provisioning rate of coalitions to yield feasible and time-efficient solutions. TRAITS provides a more accurate feasibility assessment and estimation of task execution times and makespan by leveraging trait-provisioning rates while optimizing battery consumption -- an advantage that state-of-the-art frameworks lack. We evaluate TRAITS against two state-of-the-art frameworks, with results demonstrating its advantage in satisfying complex trait and battery requirements while remaining computationally tractable.

title: Bridging the Multilingual Safety Divide: Efficient, Culturally-Aware Alignment for Global South Languages
comments: Accepted to the EGSAI Workshop at AAAI 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being deployed across the Global South, where everyday use involves low-resource languages, code-mixing, and culturally specific norms. Yet safety pipelines, benchmarks, and alignment still largely target English and a handful of high-resource languages, implicitly assuming safety and factuality ''transfer'' across languages. Evidence increasingly shows they do not. We synthesize recent findings indicating that (i) safety guardrails weaken sharply on low-resource and code-mixed inputs, (ii) culturally harmful behavior can persist even when standard toxicity scores look acceptable, and (iii) English-only knowledge edits and safety patches often fail to carry over to low-resource languages. In response, we outline a practical agenda for researchers and students in the Global South: parameter-efficient safety steering, culturally grounded evaluation and preference data, and participatory workflows that empower local communities to define and mitigate harm. Our aim is to make multilingual safety a core requirement-not an add-on-for equitable AI in underrepresented regions.
comment: Accepted to the EGSAI Workshop at AAAI 2026

title: Agentic Assistant for 6G: Turn-based Conversations for AI-RAN Hierarchical Co-Management
summary: New generations of radio access networks (RAN), especially with native AI services are increasingly difficult for human engineers to manage in real-time. Enterprise networks are often managed locally, where expertise is scarce. Existing research has focused on creating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) LLMs that can help to plan and configure RAN and core aspects only. Co-management of RAN and edge AI is the gap, which creates hierarchical and dynamic problems that require turn-based human interactions. Here, we create an agentic network manager and turn-based conversation assistant that can understand human intent-based queries that match hierarchical problems in AI-RAN. The framework constructed consists of: (a) a user interface and evaluation dashboard, (b) an intelligence layer that interfaces with the AI-RAN, and (c) a knowledge layer for providing the basis for evaluations and recommendations. These form 3 layers of capability with the following validation performances (average response time 13s): (1) design and planning a service (78\% accuracy), (2) operating specific AI-RAN tools (89\% accuracy), and (3) tuning AI-RAN performance (67\%). These initial results indicate the universal challenges of hallucination but also fast response performance success that can really reduce OPEX costs for small scale enterprise users.

title: Applying Public Health Systematic Approaches to Cybersecurity: The Economics of Collective Defense
comments: Accepted to 2025 ACSAC Workshop on Cybersecurity in Healthcare (HealthSec)
summary: The U.S. public health system increased life expectancy by more than 30 years since 1900 through systematic data collection, evidence-based intervention, and coordinated response. This paper examines whether cybersecurity can benefit from similar organizational principles. We find that both domains exhibit public good characteristics: security improvements create positive externalities that individual actors cannot fully capture, leading to systematic market failure and underinvestment. Current cybersecurity lacks fundamental infrastructure including standardized population definitions, reliable outcome measurements, understanding of transmission mechanisms, and coordinated intervention testing. Drawing on public health's transformation from fragmented local responses to coordinated evidence-based discipline, we propose a national Cyber Public Health System for systematic data collection, standardized measurement, and coordinated response. We argue government coordination is economically necessary rather than merely beneficial, and outline specific federal roles in establishing standards, funding research, coordinating response, and addressing information asymmetries that markets cannot resolve.
comment: Accepted to 2025 ACSAC Workshop on Cybersecurity in Healthcare (HealthSec)

title: ADAB: Arabic Dataset for Automated Politeness Benchmarking -- A Large-Scale Resource for Computational Sociopragmatics
comments: Paper accepted @ The Fifteenth biennial Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC2026)
summary: The growing importance of culturally-aware natural language processing systems has led to an increasing demand for resources that capture sociopragmatic phenomena across diverse languages. Nevertheless, Arabic-language resources for politeness detection remain under-explored, despite the rich and complex politeness expressions embedded in Arabic communication. In this paper, we introduce ADAB (Arabic Politeness Dataset), a new annotated Arabic dataset collected from four online platforms, including social media, e-commerce, and customer service domains, covering Modern Standard Arabic and multiple dialects (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, and Maghrebi). The dataset was annotated based on Arabic linguistic traditions and pragmatic theory, resulting in three classes: polite, impolite, and neutral. It contains 10,000 samples with linguistic feature annotations across 16 politeness categories and achieves substantial inter-annotator agreement (kappa = 0.703). We benchmark 40 model configurations, including traditional machine learning, transformer-based models, and large language models. The dataset aims to support research on politeness-aware Arabic NLP.
comment: Paper accepted @ The Fifteenth biennial Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC2026)

title: Ambient Physics: Training Neural PDE Solvers with Partial Observations
summary: In many scientific settings, acquiring complete observations of PDE coefficients and solutions can be expensive, hazardous, or impossible. Recent diffusion-based methods can reconstruct fields given partial observations, but require complete observations for training. We introduce Ambient Physics, a framework for learning the joint distribution of coefficient-solution pairs directly from partial observations, without requiring a single complete observation. The key idea is to randomly mask a subset of already-observed measurements and supervise on them, so the model cannot distinguish "truly unobserved" from "artificially unobserved", and must produce plausible predictions everywhere. Ambient Physics achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance. Compared with prior diffusion-based methods, it achieves a 62.51$\%$ reduction in average overall error while using 125$\times$ fewer function evaluations. We also identify a "one-point transition": masking a single already-observed point enables learning from partial observations across architectures and measurement patterns. Ambient Physics thus enables scientific progress in settings where complete observations are unavailable.

title: Not Seeing the Whole Picture: Challenges and Opportunities in Using AI for Co-Making Physical DIY-AT for People with Visual Impairments
comments: 20 pages, 4 figures, to be presented at CHI 2026
summary: Existing assistive technologies (AT) often adopt a one-size-fits-all approach, overlooking the diverse needs of people with visual impairments (PVI). Do-it-yourself AT (DIY-AT) toolkits offer one path toward customization, but most remain limited--targeting co-design with engineers or requiring programming expertise. Non-professionals with disabilities, including PVI, also face barriers such as inaccessible tools, lack of confidence, and insufficient technical knowledge. These gaps highlight the need for prototyping technologies that enable PVI to directly make their own AT. Building on emerging evidence that large language models (LLMs) can serve not only as visual aids but also as co-design partners, we present an exploratory study of how LLM-based AI can support PVI in the tangible DIY-AT co-making process. Our findings surface key challenges and design opportunities: the need for greater spatial and visual support, strategies for mitigating novel AI errors, and implications for designing more accessible AI-assisted prototypes.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, to be presented at CHI 2026

title: Testing BDI-based Multi-Agent Systems using Discrete Event Simulation
summary: Multi-agent systems are designed to deal with open, distributed systems with unpredictable dynamics, which makes them inherently hard to test. The value of using simulation for this purpose is recognized in the literature, although achieving sufficient fidelity (i.e., the degree of similarity between the simulation and the real-world system) remains a challenging task. This is exacerbated when dealing with cognitive agent models, such as the Belief Desire Intention (BDI) model, where the agent codebase is not suitable to run unchanged in simulation environments, thus increasing the reality gap between the deployed and simulated systems. We argue that BDI developers should be able to test in simulation the same specification that will be later deployed, with no surrogate representations. Thus, in this paper, we discuss how the control flow of BDI agents can be mapped onto a Discrete Event Simulation (DES), showing that such integration is possible at different degrees of granularity. We substantiate our claims by producing an open-source prototype integration between two pre-existing tools (JaKtA and Alchemist), showing that it is possible to produce a simulation-based testing environment for distributed BDI} agents, and that different granularities in mapping BDI agents over DESs may lead to different degrees of fidelity.

title: VSAL: A Vision Solver with Adaptive Layouts for Graph Property Detection
summary: Graph property detection aims to determine whether a graph exhibits certain structural properties, such as being Hamiltonian. Recently, learning-based approaches have shown great promise by leveraging data-driven models to detect graph properties efficiently. In particular, vision-based methods offer a visually intuitive solution by processing the visualizations of graphs. However, existing vision-based methods rely on fixed visual graph layouts, and therefore, the expressiveness of their pipeline is restricted. To overcome this limitation, we propose VSAL, a vision-based framework that incorporates an adaptive layout generator capable of dynamically producing informative graph visualizations tailored to individual instances, thereby improving graph property detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VSAL outperforms state-of-the-art vision-based methods on various tasks such as Hamiltonian cycle, planarity, claw-freeness, and tree detection.

title: NFT Games: an Empirical Look into the Play-to-Earn Model
summary: The past decade has witnessed the burgeoning and continuous development of blockchain and its applications. Besides various cryptocurrencies, an industry that has quickly embraced this trend is gaming. Thanks to the support of blockchain, games have started to incorporate non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that can enable a new gaming model, play-to-earn (P2E), which incentivizes users to participate and play. While recent studies looked at several NFT games qualitatively and individually, an in-depth understanding is still missing, particularly on how the P2E model has transformed traditional games. In this work, we set to conduct a measurement study of NFT games, aiming to gain a comprehensive understanding of the effectiveness of P2E in practice. For this purpose, we collect and analyze relevant NFT transaction data from the underlying blockchain (e.g., Ethereum) of 12 games, supplemented with various data scraped from their websites. Our study shows that (1) a few top wallets control unproportionally high percentage of NFTs, and the majority of wallets own only one or two NFTs and do not actively trade; (2) promotion events do boost the trade amount and the NFT price for some games, but their effect does not sustain; and (3) few players actually earned a profit, and players in 9 out of 12 games who traded NFTs have a negative profit on average. Motivated by these findings, we further investigate effective incentive mechanisms based on game theory to improve the trading profits that players can earn from these NFT games. Both modeling and simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed incentive mechanism.

title: Human-Aligned Evaluation of a Pixel-wise DNN Color Constancy Model
summary: We previously investigated color constancy in photorealistic virtual reality (VR) and developed a Deep Neural Network (DNN) that predicts reflectance from rendered images. Here, we combine both approaches to compare and study a model and human performance with respect to established color constancy mechanisms: local surround, maximum flux and spatial mean. Rather than evaluating the model against physical ground truth, model performance was assessed using the same achromatic object selection task employed in the human experiments. The model, a ResNet based U-Net from our previous work, was pre-trained on rendered images to predict surface reflectance. We then applied transfer learning, fine-tuning only the network's decoder on images from the baseline VR condition. To parallel the human experiment, the model's output was used to perform the same achromatic object selection task across all conditions. Results show a strong correspondence between the model and human behavior. Both achieved high constancy under baseline conditions and showed similar, condition-dependent performance declines when the local surround or spatial mean color cues were removed.

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of DINOv2 for Large-Scale Font Classification
summary: We present a font classification system capable of identifying 394 font families from rendered text images. Our approach fine-tunes a DINOv2 Vision Transformer using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), achieving approximately 86% top-1 accuracy while training fewer than 1% of the model's 87.2M parameters. We introduce a synthetic dataset generation pipeline that renders Google Fonts at scale with diverse augmentations including randomized colors, alignment, line wrapping, and Gaussian noise, producing training images that generalize to real-world typographic samples. The model incorporates built-in preprocessing to ensure consistency between training and inference, and is deployed as a HuggingFace Inference Endpoint. We release the model, dataset, and full training pipeline as open-source resources.

title: Evaluating Prompt Engineering Techniques for RAG in Small Language Models: A Multi-Hop QA Approach
comments: 32 Pages, Submitted to Journal of Computing and Security
summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a powerful approach for enhancing the factual grounding of language models by integrating external knowledge. While widely studied for large language models, the optimization of RAG for Small Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical research gap, particularly in complex, multi-hop question-answering tasks that require sophisticated reasoning. In these systems, prompt template design is a crucial yet under-explored factor influencing performance. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study to investigate this factor, evaluating 24 different prompt templates on the HotpotQA dataset. The set includes a standard RAG prompt, nine well-formed techniques from the literature, and 14 novel hybrid variants, all tested on two prominent SLMs: Qwen2.5-3B Instruct and Gemma3-4B-It. Our findings, based on a test set of 18720 instances, reveal significant performance gains of up to 83% on Qwen2.5 and 84.5% on Gemma3-4B-It, yielding an improvement of up to 6% for both models compared to the Standard RAG prompt. This research also offers concrete analysis and actionable recommendations for designing effective and efficient prompts for SLM-based RAG systems, practically for deployment in resource-constrained environments.
comment: 32 Pages, Submitted to Journal of Computing and Security

title: GSRM: Generative Speech Reward Model for Speech RLHF
summary: Recent advances in speech language models, such as GPT-4o Voice Mode and Gemini Live, have demonstrated promising speech generation capabilities. Nevertheless, the aesthetic naturalness of the synthesized audio still lags behind that of human speech. Enhancing generation quality requires a reliable evaluator of speech naturalness. However, existing naturalness evaluators typically regress raw audio to scalar scores, offering limited interpretability of the evaluation and moreover fail to generalize to speech across different taxonomies. Inspired by recent advances in generative reward modeling, we propose the Generative Speech Reward Model (GSRM), a reasoning-centric reward model tailored for speech. The GSRM is trained to decompose speech naturalness evaluation into an interpretable acoustic feature extraction stage followed by feature-grounded chain-of-thought reasoning, enabling explainable judgments. To achieve this, we curated a large-scale human feedback dataset comprising 31k expert ratings and an out-of-domain benchmark of real-world user-assistant speech interactions. Experiments show that GSRM substantially outperforms existing speech naturalness predictors, achieving model-human correlation of naturalness score prediction that approaches human inter-rater consistency. We further show how GSRM can improve the naturalness of speech LLM generations by serving as an effective verifier for online RLHF.

title: Probabilistic Reachability Analysis of Multi-scale Voltage Dynamics Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Voltage stability in modern power systems involves coupled dynamics across multiple time scales. Conventional methods based on time-scale separation or static stability margins may overlook instabilities caused by the coupling of slow and fast transients. Uncertainty in operating conditions further complicates stability assessment, and high computational cost of Monte Carlo simulations limit its applicability to multi-scale dynamics. This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning-based framework for probabilistic reachability analysis of multi-scale voltage dynamics. By formulating each instability mechanism as a distinct absorbing state and introducing a multi-critic architecture for mechanism-specific learning, the proposed method enables consistent learning of risk probabilities associated with multiple instability types within a unified framework. The approach is demonstrated on a four-bus system with load tap changers and over-excitation limiters, illustrating effectiveness of the proposed learning-based reachability analysis in identifying and quantifying the mechanisms leading to voltage collapse.

title: Revenue-Optimal Pricing for Budget-Constrained Buyers in Data Markets
summary:
We study revenue-optimal pricing in data markets with rational, budget-constrained buyers. Such a market offers multiple datasets for sale, and buyers aim to improve the accuracy of their prediction tasks by acquiring data bundles. For each dataset, the market sets a pricing function, which maps the number of records purchased from the dataset to a non-negative price. The market's objective is to set these pricing functions to maximize total revenue, considering that buyers with quasi-linear utilities choose their bundles optimally under budget constraints.
  We analyze optimal pricing when each dataset's pricing function is only required to be monotone and lower-continuous. Surprisingly, even with this generality, optimal pricing has a highly structured form: it is piecewise linear and convex (PLC) and can be computed efficiently via an LP. Moreover, the total number of kinks across all pricing functions is bounded by the number of buyers. Thus, when datasets far outnumber buyers, most pricing functions are effectively linear.
  This motivates studying linear pricing, where each record in a dataset is priced uniformly. Although competitive equilibrium gives revenue-optimal linear prices in rivalrous markets with quasi-linear buyers, we show that revenue maximization under linear pricing in data markets is APX-hard. Hence, a striking computational dichotomy emerges: fully general (nonlinear) pricing admits a polynomial-time algorithm, while the simpler linear scheme is APX-hard.
  Despite the hardness, we design a 2-approximation algorithm when datasets arrive online, and a $(1-1/e)^{-1}$-approximation algorithm for the offline setting. Our framework lays the groundwork for exploring more general pricing schemes, richer utility models, and a deeper understanding of how market structure -- rivalrous versus non-rivalrous -- shapes revenue-optimal pricing.

title: Assessing Cybersecurity Risks and Traffic Impact in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Given the promising future of autonomous vehicles, it is foreseeable that self-driving cars will soon emerge as the predominant mode of transportation. While autonomous vehicles offer enhanced efficiency, they remain vulnerable to external attacks. In this research, we sought to investigate the potential impact of cyberattacks on traffic patterns. To achieve this, we conducted simulations where cyberattacks were simulated on connected vehicles by disseminating false information to either a single vehicle or vehicle platoons. The primary objective of this research is to assess the cybersecurity challenges confronting connected and automated vehicles and propose practical solutions to minimize the adverse effects of malicious external information. In the simulation, we have implemented an innovative car-following model for the simulation of connected self-driving vehicles. This model continually monitors data received from preceding vehicles and optimizes various actions, such as acceleration, and deceleration, with the aim of maximizing overall traffic efficiency and safety.

title: UAV-SEAD: State Estimation Anomaly Dataset for UAVs
summary: Accurate state estimation in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is crucial for ensuring reliable and safe operation, as anomalies occurring during mission execution may induce discrepancies between expected and observed system behaviors, thereby compromising mission success or posing potential safety hazards. It is essential to continuously monitor and detect such conditions in order to ensure a timely response and maintain system reliability. In this work, we focus on UAV state estimation anomalies and provide a large-scale real-world UAV dataset to facilitate research aimed at improving the development of anomaly detection. Unlike existing datasets that primarily rely on injected faults into simulated data, this dataset comprises 1396 real flight logs totaling over 52 hours of flight time, collected across diverse indoor and outdoor environments using a collection of PX4-based UAVs equipped with a variety of sensor configurations. The dataset comprises both normal and anomalous flights without synthetic manipulation, making it uniquely suitable for realistic anomaly detection tasks. A structured classification is proposed that categorizes UAV state estimation anomalies into four classes: mechanical and electrical, external position, global position, and altitude anomalies. These classifications reflect collective, contextual, and outlier anomalies observed in multivariate sensor data streams, including IMU, GPS, barometer, magnetometer, distance sensors, visual odometry, and optical flow, that can be found in the PX4 logging mechanism. It is anticipated that this dataset will play a key role in the development, training, and evaluation of anomaly detection and isolation systems to address the critical gap in UAV reliability research.

title: RPGD: RANSAC-P3P Gradient Descent for Extrinsic Calibration in 3D Human Pose Estimation
comments: Accepted at AAIML 2026. This work is co-funded by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under MSCA with grant agreement No 101081674
summary: In this paper, we propose RPGD (RANSAC-P3P Gradient Descent), a human-pose-driven extrinsic calibration framework that robustly aligns MoCap-based 3D skeletal data with monocular or multi-view RGB cameras using only natural human motion. RPGD formulates extrinsic calibration as a coarse-to-fine problem tailored to human poses, combining the global robustness of RANSAC-P3P with Gradient-Descent-based refinement. We evaluate RPGD on three large-scale public 3D HPE datasets as well as on a self-collected in-the-wild dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that RPGD consistently recovers extrinsic parameters with accuracy comparable to the provided ground truth, achieving sub-pixel MPJPE reprojection error even in challenging, noisy settings. These results indicate that RPGD provides a practical and automatic solution for reliable extrinsic calibration of large-scale 3D HPE dataset collection.
comment: Accepted at AAIML 2026. This work is co-funded by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under MSCA with grant agreement No 101081674

title: Diagnosing Pathological Chain-of-Thought in Reasoning Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is fundamental to modern LLM architectures and represents a critical intervention point for AI safety. However, CoT reasoning may exhibit failure modes that we note as pathologies, which prevent it from being useful for monitoring. Prior work has identified three distinct pathologies: post-hoc rationalization, where models generate plausible explanations backwards from predetermined answers; encoded reasoning, where intermediate steps conceal information within seemingly interpretable text; and internalized reasoning, where models replace explicit reasoning with meaningless filler tokens while computing internally. To better understand and discriminate between these pathologies, we create a set of concrete metrics that are simple to implement, computationally inexpensive, and task-agnostic. To validate our approach, we develop model organisms deliberately trained to exhibit specific CoT pathologies. Our work provides a practical toolkit for assessing CoT pathologies, with direct implications for training-time monitoring.

title: Pre-Editorial Normalization for Automatically Transcribed Medieval Manuscripts in Old French and Latin
summary: Recent advances in Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) have improved access to historical archives, yet a methodological divide persists between palaeographic transcriptions and normalized digital editions. While ATR models trained on more palaeographically-oriented datasets such as CATMuS have shown greater generalizability, their raw outputs remain poorly compatible with most readers and downstream NLP tools, thus creating a usability gap. On the other hand, ATR models trained to produce normalized outputs have been shown to struggle to adapt to new domains and tend to over-normalize and hallucinate. We introduce the task of Pre-Editorial Normalization (PEN), which consists in normalizing graphemic ATR output according to editorial conventions, which has the advantage of keeping an intermediate step with palaeographic fidelity while providing a normalized version for practical usability.
